heads.en: As the voting day approached, candidates for the elections flew to the top of the political spectrum; in this context, the opening of the "second home" became a popular issue on the streets and the Internet. heads.t: 嘉峪關登眺 2026/10/29 從酒店一早出發，仰望秋天的天空，天高雲淡，秋風徐徐，炎夏的暑熱漸行漸遠。初秋時節，想不到依然藍天白雲，熱威收斂很多。畢竟，炎夏和涼秋是不同的。 下電瓶車，慢慢步行，遊興比諸先前的張掖七彩丹霞未曾稍減，在兩邊都是輕柳帶風的涼意中，身體汗勿需出；遠遠已經窺見黃土夯築的城牆連綿開去，氣勢雄偉，震撼人心。林蔭道上遊客不見擁擠，小攤接連排開。有人與你玩遊戲，城牆下的空地上還有主題歌舞演出。路邊有穿舞服的人員載歌載舞，團友裡的小邱舞細胞興奮起來，也禁不住聞歌起舞。 我們開始登城樓，居高臨下，體驗和感懷這萬里雄關的「前世今生」。…
heads.en: 2026/10/29 leaves the hotel early in the morning and looks at the autumn sky, the sky is cloudy, the autumn winds are raging, the summer heat is rising. In the early autumn, the blue sky was still a bit hot. After all, summer and autumn are different. Down with the bottle and walking slowly, the parade has not abated over the previous Zhang Zhang Zhang Zhi Dang Zha, and the body has not had to sweat in the coolness of light-wielding wind on both sides; far from seeing the walls of the yellow earth's cathedral open, the air is great, and the heart is shaken. There was no crowding of tourists on the forest tunnel, and the stand opened. Some people play games with you and there's a theme dance show in the open under the walls. There are dancers on the side of the road in their clothes, and the Qiu cells in their group members are excited and can't stop hearing them. We began to go to the city building, to sit down, to experience and feel the "life of the past." I don't know.

heads.t: 《美好金門》未來的未來 2026/10/06 民國100年我以共同計畫主持人角色，參與由 AECOM 承辦的《金門縣概念性總體規劃》，且協力負責交通與觀光專題，因此有機會仔細審視「金廈連結」的規劃理念是否經得起考驗。 跨境交通真正需要有效移動的是人，而不是車。 當年我邀請旅美交通專家楊成欽博士參與金門總體規劃。楊博士提出的軌道交通構想，不只是一條軌道，而是一套多元交通串聯的理念；尤其強調跨界交通必須與島嶼內部交通、土地使用及未來發展有機結合。 如果以跨界軌道及公共運輸作為骨幹，把水頭碼頭、金門機場與未來可能形成的跨境節點串聯起來，改變的就不只是交通方式，而有機會重塑金門整體空間的發展格局。…
heads.en: The future of Good Golden Gate 2026/10/06, in which I have been a co-producer for 100 years, participated in the AECOM Conceptual General Plan for Golden Gate County, and worked together on the topic of transport and tourism, thus providing an opportunity to examine whether the concept of "Golden House Link" is acceptable. It is people, not cars, that really need to move effectively across borders. In the same year, I invited Dr. Yang Sung-chun, a travel expert in the United States, to participate in the general planning of the Golden Gate. Dr. Yang's idea of a rail transport structure is not just a track, but a concept of a multifaceted traffic chain; it is particularly important that cross-border traffic be linked to intra-island transport, land use and future development. If cross-border orbits and public transport are used as a backbone, linking the water dock, the Golden Gate airport, and the possible future cross-border nodes change not only the mode of transport, but also the opportunity to reshape the entire gold gate. I don't know.
